name: occupancy_summary
description: Units, vacant units, occupied units, % vacant and % occupied per property. Physical vacancy: same definition as vacant_units (reserved/held units count as vacant), so vacancy + occupancy = 100%. Use for occupancy rate.

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

include_other_rentables.description: also count parking/storage and other rentable items as units

headline: {sum:vacantUnits} of {sum:totalUnits} units physically vacant ({pct:vacantUnits/totalUnits}); {sum:occupiedUnits} occupied ({pct:occupiedUnits/totalUnits}) across {count} property(ies) as of {as_of}.
answer_hint: Occupancy = physically vacant rule, same as vacant_units (reserved/held units count as vacant; active properties, no parking/other rentables by default), so vacancy% + occupancy% = 100% and vacant equals the vacant_units count. vacancy_report lists the same units (a few unit types such as event rooms are omitted by that report; it prints the differences).
